description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
